# OutLoud

> Good moments deserve to be heard. OutLoud helps communities, brands, and creators find moments in recordings, trim clips, add captions, design audiograms, and share the parts worth hearing. Optional dubbing is available for supported languages.

## Public product information
- [OutLoud](https://outloud.nana.works/): Browser-based application. Workflow: Input, Clip, Design, Share.
- [How OutLoud works](https://outloud.nana.works/about): Capabilities, workflow, access requirements, and limitations.
- [NANA](https://nana.works/): Creator and studio context.

## Current capabilities
Upload audio/video, record microphone audio, or capture tab audio where supported. Trim manually; optionally analyze to find moments and search a transcript. Create synchronized captions and digital or analog waveform audiograms. Download video, audio, SRT, or VTT. Dubbing supports the languages listed in the app, not every language.

## Boundaries
OutLoud is free for clips: anyone can upload a recording up to 2 hours and 300 MB, trim a moment, and add original-audio captions up to 2 minutes, 3 clips a day, then design and export. Free exports carry a small NANA mark. Pro (by password during the beta) adds ANALYZE for suggested moments and transcript search, dubbing, captions up to 12 minutes and the watermark toggle; provider usage limits apply. Direct URL import is not currently available. Video formats and capture support vary by browser. Audio processing uses external services; the composition renders in the browser. See the app’s data-handling dialog. This is a public product reference, not documentation for a public automation API.
